scope: All entries with rust_export.status=passed and stage1_compile.status=failed. One recorded Cargo build per entry, exit code 101. No optimization or Stage 2 for these entries.

counting_method.entries: Cause coverage overlaps; a single entry can have more than one cause.
counting_method.diagnostics: Each original rustc error header, excluding the final could not compile summary, is counted exactly once and assigned one cause. Counts are observed diagnostics, not numbers of bugs or failed functions.
counting_method.limitations: No patches or compile reruns. Fixing observed causes may expose more diagnostics and does not establish runtime correctness.
